draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.41, the 23rd-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 4th of 36 at CB. He lasted until pick 60, well after his grade rank (23rd): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Avonte Maddox. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (99th percentile), 10-yard split (97th percentile), broad jump (80th percentile). College production: 10 passes defended in 2022, 7th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Cincinnati Bengals. 45 career games and 34 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (6 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: passes defended 18 (99th percentile), completion % allowed 47.9% (96th percentile), season snap share 89.4% (91st percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 89.4% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, above the norm.
